visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor studio with a yellow backdrop featuring the logo 'PressPlay'. A young woman wearing a white and tan paneled shirt and black pants stands on the left, while a young man in a black long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans stands on the right. Both are positioned within green tape squares on the floor. A split-screen overlay at the top shows a black man and a woman demonstrating marching in place. (2) As a large blue digital '3' graphic appears and fades, the main pair begins marching in place with their eyes tightly shut. The man repeatedly reaches out his right arm to poke and push the woman's shoulder, causing her to wobble and laugh while trying to maintain her position. Various colorful text overlays and cartoon-style graphics like red 'anger' icons appear periodically around them as they continue their rhythmic marching. (3) A large, stylized 'Times UP!' graphic in yellow and black pops onto the screen, prompting the pair to stop and open their eyes. The man is clearly seen to have drifted several feet forward and to the right, completely out of his green square, while the woman has remained almost perfectly centered within hers. A red arrow points to the man's feet on the floor to emphasize his displacement. (4) The woman celebrates her victory as yellow stars and a 'WINNER' graphic float around her, while the man points at her accusingly with a smirk. They engage in a brief, animated conversation with hand gestures, ending with the woman giving a thumbs-up to the camera while a cat-eared icon with a social media handle appears above her head.
